title: Review independent neutral transport and comparison contract
goal: Freeze a bounded non-JSON codec and candidate-specific equality projections.
acceptance_criteria: Protocol directly represents wire units, ordered duplicate members, exact tokens, numerical bits and result classes.
Length framing and decode limits are explicit; candidate JSON parsing cannot serve as its own oracle transport.
Comparison domains distinguish grammar, profile, numeric, limit and infrastructure disagreements.
scope_rule: Only explicitly sealed artifact/file scope; meaning, checker, workflow, release and reporting changes require dedicated independent human review.
null_binding_reason: Candidate project source exists, but this template's task-specific reviewed target, dependency and acceptance identities are not sealed; the applicable manual-review policy or qualified validator must be frozen before any live claim.
